title: TriFleetRCA: On-Premise LLM Root Cause Analysis for Kubernetes
abstract: arXiv:2609.23766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Root cause analysis at a remote site is slow: evidence is scattered across pod logs, Kubernetes events and cluster-level objects, and many operators cannot send production logs to a hosted model at all. On-premise inference removes the second constraint but raises a question live-cluster benchmarks have not addressed: when one workstation GPU fixes both the model and the context budget, how should evidence be retrieved, and what happens when the runbooks the model consults have been tampered with? We present TriFleetRCA, a pipeline running entirely on one on-premise GPU that collects evidence at one of three scopes (pod, namespace, cluster), ranks it by template de-duplication then BM25, filters runbooks through an ingest guard, and returns a root cause with the evidence lines supporting it. We evaluate on a live Kubernetes cluster into which we inject four faults, so ground truth is known by construction, across 100 analyses with Qwen

translated_title: TriFleetRCA：基于本地部署大语言模型的 Kubernetes 根因分析
translated_abstract: 远程站点的根因分析速度缓慢：证据分散在 Pod 日志、Kubernetes 事件和集群级对象之中，而且许多运维人员根本无法将生产日志发送给云端托管模型。本地部署推理消除了第二个限制，但也提出了一个现有实时集群基准测试尚未解决的问题：当一块工作站 GPU 同时固定了模型和上下文预算时，应该如何检索证据？当模型所参考的运行手册被篡改时又会发生什么？我们提出了 TriFleetRCA，这是一个完全运行在单块本地 GPU 上的流水线，它在三个范围（Pod、命名空间、集群）之一收集证据，先通过模板去重再用 BM25 进行排序，通过摄取防护机制过滤运行手册，并返回根因及其支持证据行。我们在一个实时 Kubernetes 集群上进行评估，向其中注入四种故障，因此真值在构建时即为已知，并使用 Qwen 进行了 100 次分析。
tldr: 提出了 TriFleetRCA，一个完全运行在单块本地 GPU 上的 Kubernetes 根因分析流水线，通过多范围证据收集、模板去重加 BM25 排序以及运行手册摄取防护，在模型和上下文预算受限的条件下实现可靠且可抵御运行手册篡改的根因分析。
en_tdlr: TriFleetRCA is a fully on-premise, single-GPU pipeline for Kubernetes root cause analysis that collects evidence at pod, namespace, or cluster scope, ranks it via template de-duplication and BM25, and uses an ingest guard to defend against tampered runbooks.
